title: 第9章 首次战斗第10章 韦伯利家的密道

第九章首次战斗
“疯子？神经病，我还要将拯救世界的任务交给你呢！”
郝宁从灰鼠的黑店中心中不免诽谤几句，他现在还要去完成那个搜索韦伯利子爵秘密的任务，没空陪着这些疯子玩耍。
他从刚刚走了两步，眼前的阳光瞬间暗淡了下来，骤然间一股危机感在郝宁心中涌现，他下意识地往身旁跃去！
忽然间一声刺耳的空气撕裂声在他耳边响起，刹那间他原来站立的地方仿佛炸弹般瞬间爆开。
轰的一声！郝宁眼前扬起一阵浓郁的灰尘，顿时街道上所有人都好奇的目光投向郝宁，对于他们来说，这样的战斗在玫瑰街每天都不知道要发生多少次。
就在这时候灰尘中走出一个穿着黑色盔甲独眼壮汉，他猛然一甩手中的黑铁大砍刀，刀刃撕裂空气迸发出一阵强风吹散眼前的灰尘。
“你是谁！”郝宁眼带警惕地望着眼前的男子，与此同时心中也启动侦察术，一行信息出现在他的眼前。
雷诺.斯塔恩
23级剑士（青铜中等实力）
简介：斯塔恩是玫瑰街的治安长官，负责着这里的治安，由于他那糟糕的管理方式，这里简直比竞技场那般混乱！或许安排他来管理这里，是罗德斯子爵生命中最糟糕的决定。
“我是来替他们报仇的，今天刚好听说你抢了他们的东西！身为这里的治安长官，我当然要为他们讨回公道！”
斯塔恩一手将人群中的两人给拉了出来，郝宁认得出来，那两人就是被他打劫的盗贼，但他想不到他们竟然会这么快就来报复。忽然他想到，脸上的面容已经改变过，他们是怎么把自己认出来的？
“不好意思，我不知道你在这说什么！”郝宁冷声说道。
“就是他！我记得身上的衣服，没有改变，他的脸上一定是用了什么伪装的工具。”其中一个被打的盗贼突然跳出来指着郝宁大声喝道，那样子就仿佛郝宁亲手杀了他爸妈一般。
郝宁留意到一旁围观的然人中，有好一些人顿时都对斯塔恩投去仇恨的目光，似乎都对斯塔恩敢怒不敢言。郝宁对此有些诧异，他印象中好像城主夫人的姓氏也叫斯塔恩，顿时他心中想明白了，怪不得罗德斯子爵会排一个只有青铜阶实力的人管理玫瑰街。
虽然这个斯塔恩的实力只有青铜阶，但这也容不得郝宁放松警惕！毕竟现在他还是一个青铜阶都算不上的人，最多也就比普通人力气大很多而已，而且如果刚刚的剑气砍到他身上，就有可能瞬间将他砍成两半。
“如果你对这次的判罚有任何异议，可以用你的实力打败我！当然对于你这样的弱者，我只会使用一半的实力。”
斯塔恩随意地舞动着手中的黑铁大砍刀，阵阵撕裂空气的声音随着刀刃响起，他那看向郝宁的目光就仿佛在说你这弱小的家伙，我就算用一只手都能将你打败。
“该死，这群士兵都是不用干活的吗！”

郝宁面露难色地后退两步，他现在还没自大到认为自己完全可以打败一个23级的剑士，他现在的等级也只是0级，而且一个攻击技能都还没有。
他还注意到人群中竟然还有着一些菲尼斯的士兵，看来自己已经被包围了。
忽然间郝宁还没点下头，斯塔恩跨出两步，就提着手中大砍刀往郝宁身上砍去，呼啸的声音无时无刻都在提示着这一刀的威力！
郝宁心中一惊，怎么自己还没答应，他就开始攻击！他虽然也感到惊讶，但他没有愣愣站在原地被他砍，双脚一蹬，整个人往后跃去，与此同时时他还在物品栏中快速切换出已经装备的柯尔特左轮手枪。
他以前从来没有使用过枪，但此时已经没有时间让他练习，一阵跄踉后双手握枪，平举在身前对准斯塔恩，顿时一股奇妙的感觉在他心中涌出，他进入了专注的状态，眼中只剩下一击不中继续挥舞着砍刀的斯塔恩。
“砰！砰砰！”郝宁迅速瞄准眼前的目标扣动扳机，连续开出了三枪，硝烟在他面前弥漫着。
而斯塔恩对于郝宁避开他的斩击显然有些惊讶，但他并不在意，于是他再次挥动手中砍刀往那个家伙身上砍去！
忽然身为剑士的他心中涌出一阵危机感，那种威胁到生命感觉，忽然他耳边连续响起三声闷响，三颗黑乎乎的珠子以肉眼难以看见的速度飞向他的身体，他立即将手中的砍刀砍向那三颗黑珠子。
“该死！矮人的武器！”骤然间一股巨力在刀刃上传来，几乎让斯塔恩手中的刀脱手而出，这丝毫不逊色于他的全力一击。
虽然他成功让一个子弹改变了轨迹，但是剩余的两颗子弹却不是他能够抵挡的，顿时仿佛一柄巨锤击在斯塔恩身上，他向后倒腾两步，直直地倒在地上！
瞬间围观的人群顿时响起一阵欢呼声，他们想不到会发生这么戏剧化的事情，一个就连青铜骑士都算不上的家伙，竟然用神奇的道具将人人都讨厌的斯塔恩杀死了。
其实就连郝宁也想不到这柄手枪的威力会这么大，至少在他的印象中，这柄枪的威力要比地球那些枪支的威力大上一些。
“该死！想不到你竟然会有矮人的武器，不，这应该还加持了魔法，不然威力不会这么大！”
本该“死去”的斯塔恩突然爬了起来骂咧咧地说着，他心有余悸地望着郝宁手中的柯尔特左轮手枪，他的盔甲上还残留着两个冒着白烟的弹孔。
他脸上露出狞笑地说：“既然你拥有这样的武器，那么我也不该手下留情了，一不小心我也会死掉的！”
对着郝宁来说，这是一个非常糟糕的消息，他的枪现在只剩下三颗子弹。如果这三颗子弹不能击中斯塔恩的脑袋，被斯塔恩近身，等待他的只有死路一条，他现在迫切需要一柄近身武器。
骤然间斯塔恩狞笑一声，猛然挥动手中砍刀，一道近乎透明的剑气迸发而出，切开空气的阻挡往郝宁斩去。
郝宁狼狈地滚向一边，侥幸地躲过斯塔恩的斩击，仅仅是剑气擦脸而过，他已经感受到脸上迸发出一道伤口，鲜血在空中飞舞。
他会还没来得及喘气，斯塔恩的斩击再次来临，他只能再次狼狈躲避，但斯塔恩的攻击越来越快，郝宁虽然拥有11点敏捷属性，但抵挡不住斯塔恩那狂风暴雨的攻击。
突然间郝宁奋力一跃躲开了斯塔恩狠戾一击，但斯塔恩脸上却浮现出阴谋得逞的笑容！他的砍击动作竟然是假的，猛然将刀刃往上撩起，做出一个上挑的技能动作，一道呈现出黑色的剑气从刀刃上猛然涌出！

糟了！郝宁现在漂浮在空中，根本不能再次做出躲避的动作，死亡的危机感蔓延在他的心头。
忽然间郝宁感到口袋中传来一阵滚烫的感觉，就仿佛有一块烧红的烙铁放在他口袋一般。时间在这一瞬间慢了下来，斯塔恩的动作就仿佛按下减速键般慢了下来！
郝宁心中充满了骇然，这不是刚刚在黑店中的场景么？难道是因为那截断刃和剑柄的缘故？
但留给郝宁的时间并不多，因为他不知道让时间缓慢的效果还会持续多久！漂浮在空中的他毅然使尽全身力气将手中左轮手枪举起，瞄准斯塔恩的脑袋再次扣下扳机。
“砰！”
随着枪声响起，时间在这一瞬间恢复流逝，郝宁因为左轮手枪的反作用力重重从空中摔下来，顿时背上涌现出一阵火辣的感觉。
斯塔恩仿佛已经看到眼前这个嚣张男子被自己砍成两半的场景，突然间一颗黑漆漆的子弹仿佛转移般瞬间出现在他眼前，他心中第一次产生自己即将死亡的错觉。
“不！不！我不能死，我怎么可能被这家伙杀死？”斯塔恩心中充满了不甘。
他咬着牙往往身侧挪去，希望能够躲开着致命的攻击，但事与愿违，最终他还是没能完全躲过这次攻击。斯塔恩他感到脖子上一热，鲜血瞬间染红了整个身体，仿佛一只扯线木偶般跄踉走了两步，跌倒在地上。
就在斯塔恩倒下的瞬间，他的眼中闪过一行字幕！
宿主获得成就：首次战斗！奖励经验200，购买点数50！
此时郝宁脸上带着难以置信的表情看着手中的柯尔特左轮手枪，他一个0级的新人竟然打败了23级的剑士斯塔恩，太难以置信了，虽然这过程有些运气成分。
“长官！”
斯塔恩手下的士兵立即从他的死亡讯息中恢复过来，他们根本想不到自己的长官会让这个还没到青铜阶实力的普通人杀死！
转眼间他们就掏出腰间的制式长剑将郝宁围住，但是都不敢上前对郝宁进行攻击，唯恐郝宁手中杀死斯塔恩的神秘家伙会对着他们来一发。
但这时候郝宁心中却没有感到喜悦，刚侥幸搞定了一个，转眼间又被一群士兵给围上。
“放他走吧！你们的长官还没死，你们不用担心罗德斯城主的怪责。”
就在郝宁与他们僵持的时候灰鼠那黑店的门被。

Chapter 9 The First Battle
"Crazy? Crazy, I still want to give you the task of saving the world!"
Hao Ning couldn't help but slander a few words from the center of Squirrel's black shop. He now has to complete the task of searching for Viscount Webley's secrets and has no time to play with these madmen.
He had just taken two steps, and the sunlight in front of him dimmed instantly. Suddenly, a sense of crisis emerged in Hao Ning's heart, and he subconsciously jumped to his side!
Suddenly, a harsh sound of tearing air sounded in his ears, and the place where he was standing suddenly exploded like a bomb.
Boom! A thick cloud of dust rose up in front of Hao Ning's eyes, and suddenly everyone on the street turned their curious eyes to Hao Ning. For them, such battles happened countless times every day on Rose Street.
Just at this moment, a strong one-eyed man wearing black armor walked out of the dust. He suddenly swung the black iron machete in his hand, and the blade tore through the air and released a strong gust of wind that blew away the dust in front of him.
"Who are you!" Hao Ning looked at the man in front of him with vigilance. At the same time, he also activated the reconnaissance technique in his heart, and a line of information appeared in front of him.
Renaud Starn
Level 23 Swordsman (Bronze Medium Strength)
Introduction: Starn is the chief of security of Rose Street and is responsible for the security here. Due to his poor management methods, this place is simply more chaotic than the arena! Perhaps arranging him to manage this place was the worst decision in Viscount Rhodes' life.
"I'm here to avenge them. I just heard today that you robbed their things! As the chief of security here, of course I want to seek justice for them!"
Starn pulled two people out of the crowd with one hand. Hao Ning recognized them as the thieves he robbed, but he didn't expect that they would come to take revenge so quickly. Suddenly he thought that the appearance on his face had changed. How did they recognize him?
"Sorry, I don't know what you are talking about here!" Hao Ning said coldly.
"That's him! I remember that the clothes on his body have not changed. He must have used some disguise on his face." One of the beaten thieves suddenly jumped out and pointed at Hao Ning and shouted loudly, as if Hao Ning had killed his parents with his own hands.
Hao Ning noticed that among the people watching on the side, many people immediately cast hateful glances at Starn, as if they were too angry to speak to Starn. Hao Ning was a little surprised by this. He had the impression that the surname of the city lord's wife was also named Starn. He suddenly understood in his mind, no wonder Viscount Rhodes would arrange a person with only bronze level strength to manage Rose Street.
Although this Starn's strength is only Bronze level, this does not allow Hao Ning to relax his vigilance! After all, he is still a person who is not even at the bronze level. At most, he is much stronger than ordinary people. Moreover, if the sword energy just struck him, it might cut him in half instantly.
"If you have any objections to this penalty, you can use your strength to defeat me! Of course, for a weakling like you, I will only use half of my strength."
Starn waved the black iron machete in his hand casually, and the sound of tearing the air echoed with the blade. The look he looked at Hao Ning seemed to say, you are a weak guy, I can defeat you even with one hand.
"Damn it, these soldiers don't have to work!"
Hao Ning took two steps back with a look of embarrassment. He was not yet arrogant enough to think that he could defeat a level 23 swordsman. His current level was only level 0, and he didn't have any attack skills.
He also noticed that there were some Phoenix soldiers in the crowd, and it seemed that he had been surrounded.
Suddenly, before Hao Ning nodded, Starn took two steps and slashed at Hao Ning with the machete in his hand. The whistling sound reminded him of the power of this knife all the time!
Hao NingxinI was shocked, why didn't he agree before he started to attack! Although he was also surprised, he did not stand there blankly and was chopped down by him. He kicked off his feet and jumped back. At the same time, he quickly switched out the equipped Colt revolver in the inventory.
He had never used a gun before, but there was no time for him to practice at this time. After staggering for a while, he held the gun with both hands and raised it flat in front of him and pointed it at Starn. Suddenly, a strange feeling surged in his heart. He entered a state of concentration. Only Starn who missed a single hit and continued to wield the machete was in his eyes.
"Bang! Bang bang!" Hao Ning quickly aimed at the target in front of him and pulled the trigger. He fired three shots in succession, and smoke filled the air in front of him.
Starn was obviously a little surprised that Hao Ning avoided his slash, but he didn't care, so he swung the machete in his hand and slashed at the guy again!
Suddenly, as a swordsman, he felt a sense of crisis in his heart, a feeling that threatened his life. Suddenly, there were three muffled sounds in his ears, and three black beads flew toward his body at a speed that was difficult to see with the naked eye. He immediately slashed at the three black beads with the machete in his hand.
"Damn it! The dwarf's weapon!" Suddenly a huge force came from the blade, almost making Starn's knife fall out of his hand. This was no less than his full blow.
Although he succeeded in changing the trajectory of one bullet, the remaining two bullets were not something he could resist. It was as if a giant hammer hit Starn. He took two steps back and fell straight to the ground!
Instantly, the crowd of onlookers burst into cheers. They could not have imagined that such a dramatic thing would happen. A guy who was not even a Bronze Knight actually used magical props to kill Starn, whom everyone hated.
In fact, even Hao Ning didn't expect this pistol to be so powerful. At least in his impression, this gun was more powerful than the guns on Earth.
"Damn it! I didn't expect you to have a dwarf weapon. No, it should be blessed with magic, otherwise it wouldn't be so powerful!"
Starn, who was supposed to be "dead", suddenly got up and cursed. He looked at the Colt revolver in Hao Ning's hand with lingering fear. There were still two bullet holes with white smoke in his armor.
He said with a ferocious smile on his face: "Since you have such a weapon, then I shouldn't be merciful. If I'm not careful, I will die!"
This is very bad news for Hao Ning. His gun now only has three bullets left. If these three bullets could not hit Starn's head and Starn got close to him, there would be only death waiting for him. He was in urgent need of a close-quarters weapon.
Suddenly, Starn laughed ferociously and swung the machete in his hand. A nearly transparent sword energy burst out, cutting through the air barrier and slashing towards Hao Ning.
Hao Ning rolled to the side in embarrassment, and luckily escaped Starn's slash. The sword energy just passed by his face, and he could already feel a wound bursting out on his face, and blood flying in the air.
Before he could take a breath, Starn's slash came again, and he could only evade in embarrassment again, but Starn's attacks were getting faster and faster. Although Hao Ning had 11 points of agility, he could not withstand Starn's violent attack.
Suddenly, Hao Ning jumped to avoid Starn's brutal blow, but Starn had a smile on his face that showed he had succeeded! His slashing action turned out to be fake. He suddenly lifted the blade upwards and made an upward movement. A black sword energy suddenly surged out from the blade!
Oops! Hao Ning was now floating in the air, unable to make any evasive movements at all. The sense of crisis of death spread in his heart.
Suddenly, Hao Ning felt a hot feeling in his pocket, as if a red-hot iron was placed in his pocket. hourTime slowed down at this moment, and Starn's movements slowed down as if pressing the slowdown button!
Hao Ning was filled with shock. Wasn't this the scene in the black shop just now? Is it because of the cut-off blade and hilt?
But Hao Ning didn't have much time left, because he didn't know how long the effect of slowing down time would last! Floating in the air, he resolutely raised the revolver in his hand with all his strength, aimed at Starn's head and pulled the trigger again.
"Bang!"
As the gunfire rang out, time resumed passing at this moment. Hao Ning fell heavily from the air due to the reaction force of the revolver, and a hot feeling suddenly appeared on his back.
Starn seemed to have seen the scene in front of him of the arrogant man being chopped in half. Suddenly, a black bullet appeared in front of him as if transferred. For the first time, he had the illusion that he was about to die.
"No! No! I can't die, how could I be killed by this guy?" Starn's heart was full of unwillingness.
He gritted his teeth and moved to his side, hoping to avoid the fatal attack, but it backfired, and in the end he was still unable to completely avoid the attack. Starn felt a heat on his neck, and the blood instantly stained his entire body red. He staggered two steps and fell to the ground like a puppet on strings.
The moment Starn fell, a line of subtitles flashed in his eyes!
The host gets the achievement: First battle! Reward 200 experience points and 50 purchase points!
At this time, Hao Ning looked at the Colt revolver in his hand with an expression of disbelief on his face. It was unbelievable that he, a level 0 newcomer, had defeated the level 23 swordsman Starn, although there was some luck in the process.
"Sir!"
Starn's soldiers immediately recovered from the news of his death. They never imagined that their commander would let this ordinary person who had not reached the bronze level kill him!
In the blink of an eye, they took out the standard swords from their waists and surrounded Hao Ning, but they did not dare to attack Hao Ning, fearing that the mysterious guy who killed Starn in Hao Ning's hands would take a shot at them.
But at this time, Hao Ning felt no joy in his heart. He had just managed to get one by luck, and in the blink of an eye he was surrounded by a group of soldiers.
"Let him go! Your commander is not dead yet, so you don't have to worry about Lord Rhodes' censure."
Just when Hao Ning was in a stalemate with them, the door quilt of Squirrel's black shop was opened.
